title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda to Amazon Bedrock
description: Make a request to Bedrock via API Gateway.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Amazon API Gateway receives the HTTP POST request containing the prompt.

AWS Lambda is triggered by the API Gateway endpoint. This function forwards the prompt to Amazon Bedrock API using boto3 bedrock-runtime API. It uses Anthropic Claude-v2 model and sets other required parameters to fixed values for simplicity.
Based on the given prompt, using the Anthropic Claude-v2 model, Amazon Bedrock generates the content and returns the response to Lambda.
Lambda processes the Bedrock output and sends it back to the user via API Gateway.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
